key_insight: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution (HACE) lets a specialist foundation model and an LLM agent improve each other through reciprocal learning, so both adapt as capability changes.
engineering_relevance: For materials discovery, HACE offers a scalable way to upgrade crystal-stability predictors by coupling supervised specialist training with agent-driven exploration and adaptive interaction design.
method: Train the specialist model with supervised learning on improved experiences.
Train the agent with on-policy reinforced self-training using verified gains from the current specialist.
Use evolutionary search to adapt the interaction harness: how models share information and choose training examples.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation across three domains—recommendation systems, protein function prediction, and crystal stability prediction—and states HACE outperforms prior self-improving methods on the main task metrics in all three.
watch_item: Performance depends on a reliable verification signal and a well-tuned interaction harness, which may be costly or sensitive to domain-specific evaluation quality.
